environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with task role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/inventory-svc-task-role. Container runs as root (uid 0) with full filesystem access. Environment variables include DATABASE_URL with RDS credentials, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN. The /app/logs directory is writable and mounted on an EFS volume shared with the analytics pipeline. No input validation middleware configured. Node.js 18.x runtime with default V8 settings.
